subject: kraft pulp mill excess heat
note: the high-temperature fraction of a conventional market kraft mill's excess heat; MOST of the excess heat is around 40 degC. Cutting the mill's water use increases the share available at the higher temperature. This is the number that decides whether a heat pump or a plain heat exchanger is the right district-heating option, so it matters for the tier work.
